newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Concord property arm in shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Concord property arm in shr offer.

text.p: Concord Land Development Co Ltd, the property arm of Pacific Concord Holdings Ltd, said on Monday it will offer 300 million old and new shares at a price range of HK$3.34-3.96 per share.
The issue price will be fixed on November 1, the company said in a statement.
It said approximately HK$1.1 billion would be raised through the offer and placing of 220.9 million new shares and 79.1 million existing vendor shares.
Out of these total 300 million shares, 85 percent will be placed with institutional investors, and the remaining 15 percent will be offered to the public, the company said.
The initial public offer in Hong Kong will start from October 29 to November 1 and dealing in the shares to begin on November 7, it added.
